knowledge-base.name: consult-mode
knowledge-base.triggers: consult mode, auto mode, architectural decision, collaborative, propose before coding, ask before implementing, free roam
knowledge-base.overview: ClaudeBoost CONSULT/AUTO mode protocol. CONSULT is the default — Claude researches, proposes, and asks before any architectural decision. AUTO is a bypass for prototyping and trivial work.

session-approvals.purpose: Remember architectural choices the user approved earlier in this session so Claude does not re-consult on the same axis
session-approvals.lifecycle: Cleared at SessionStart. Written by main agent after each AskUserQuestion approval. Read before every architectural-decision classification.

architectural-triggers.overview: A change fires CONSULT protocol if it introduces or alters any of these:
architectural-triggers.trigger: New public API surface: HTTP endpoint, RPC handler, CLI command, exported library function
New persistence: table, migration, collection, cache namespace, queue/topic, schema change
New module/package boundary or new stateful class
New dependency in package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml, pom.xml
Cross-cutting concern: auth/authz, validation strategy, error handling, logging shape, rate limiting, caching, retry/backoff, serialization
New middleware, interceptor, or pipeline stage
New config surface: env var, config key, feature flag
New concurrency primitive: worker, thread, queue, event loop

not-triggers.overview: Claude proceeds silently on these (no consultation):
not-triggers.item: Single-file bugfix with no signature change
Value-only config tweak on existing keys
Edits under workspace/, .claude/, knowledge/, plans/, docs/

consultation-protocol.step: Call POST http://127.0.0.1:8612/search with feature keywords). Call POST http://127.0.0.1:8612/context with architect-agent + task. Read 2-3 relevant project files. Draft the architect-agent spawn prompt with file:line citations. NO GUESSING — if you cannot cite existing code, you did not research enough.

Task(architect-agent, "PROPOSAL_ONLY — citations: file:line, file:line, ...") Opus model is required (architect-agent is always Opus). architect-agent returns 2-3 grounded options plus a "Required by standards" section listing non-negotiable RAG-sourced constraints.

Use AskUserQuestion with 2-4 options (A, B, C, each with a 1-sentence tradeoff). User picks, edits, or writes in a new option (e.g., "do D — also enforce size cap and ASCII-only"). DO NOT write any code yet.
Append to state/session-approvals.json: {axis, choice, at}. This prevents re-consulting on the same axis later in the session.

Implement the approved option plus any user add-on constraints. RAG-required standards (parameterized queries, logger.error in catch, etc.) are applied automatically throughout — they were never up for debate.

additive-not-gatekeeping.principle: CONSULT mode is NOT asking "may I do this?" — it is announcing "here is what I am about to do, so you can add constraints I should layer on."
additive-not-gatekeeping.rag-required: RAG-sourced standards are applied without consultation: SQL parameterization, logger.error in catch blocks, input validation at boundaries, auth checks on endpoints, no secrets in logs. These are not options — they always happen.
additive-not-gatekeeping.user-layer: User's role in consultation is to ADD constraints: size caps, character allowlists, rate limits, retry budgets, timeout values, acceptable input formats, error message wording, observability hooks. Claude's proposal names the defaults; user refines.
additive-not-gatekeeping.example: Feature: "add file upload endpoint" Claude proposal: "Using multer middleware, streaming to S3 via signed URL. Required by standards: parameterized DB insert for metadata, logger.error in catch, auth-token check on endpoint, no filename in logs." User adds: "also: 10MB size cap, only .png/.jpg/.pdf extensions, reject filenames with non-ASCII characters, rate-limit to 5/min/user." Claude implements both layers.

research-first-contract.enforcement: architect-agent refuses to produce a proposal if the spawn prompt contains "PROPOSAL_ONLY" but no file:line citations. Returns status=BLOCKED with message "Main agent did not research first. Call POST http://127.0.0.1:8612/search, read 2-3 relevant files, respawn with citations."
research-first-contract.rationale: Research-first is a contract, not a suggestion. Prevents generic architecture advice disconnected from this project's conventions.

auto-mode.behavior: Claude proceeds autonomously on architectural decisions but still cites patterns it follows. No architect-agent spawn. No AskUserQuestion.
auto-mode.when-to-use: Prototyping, exploration, trivial work where the user has said "just do it". Rework cost is low.
auto-mode.when-not-to-use: Production code, security-sensitive areas, cross-cutting concerns, anything the user might want to see first.

slash-commands.command: Switch to AUTO mode. Bypass consultation.

hook.purpose: Load full CONSULT protocol into every session's context
Fire at the moment of violation — classification check and protocol reminder
Reinforce PROPOSAL_ONLY contract when spawning architect-agent
Re-inject CONSULT/AUTO rule after context compaction
